system.description:
Tearing apart the bonds that hold your body together, you crumble in an instant into a desiccated heap of ash, yet your consciousness lingers within the fine grey detritus.

Expend two Blood Traits while concentrating for a full turn; when you take your action you collapse into a pile of thick, sticky ash. You can vaguely sense your surroundings out to about ten feet and are completely immune to physical attacks, fire and sunlight. You reform later into your original body, but if any of the ash is deliberately separated the largest remaining pile reforms as you, and you take lethal health levels of damage proportional to how much substance was removed. Reforming inside a container bursts it apart.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
